title: Cataclysm 2.0 — THE CATACOMBS

approved_policy.source_priority: Latest creator correction > approved roadmap/ledger > scoped milestone order > cited earlier feedback > studio suggestions
approved_policy.acceptance_status: Draft feature is NOT implemented simply because listed. Working source/test, screenshot/playable proof and final creator judgment are separate.
approved_policy.change_control: No requirement silently disappears. Defer or revise with reason, owner authority, dependencies and impacted version.
approved_policy.release_policy: Playability required; rough visuals and nonfatal bugs allowed; preserve frozen versions and maintain each version URL.

product_identity.version_order_note: Custom display labels, NOT semver ordering. Sort by release_order, including 1.69 between 1.6 and 1.7.

notes_latest_creator_correction: 2026-11-14: releases are cumulative improvements to one Cataclysm game. Every version must move source, mechanics, content, illustration, animation, sound and integration forward from the previous playable version. All eight intermediate versions are meaningful; do not skip 1.7, and do not mis-sort custom 1.69.
